name: deadcode-scanner
description: Dead code detection for JS/TS repos using Knip — finds unused files, exports, types, enum members, and dependencies. Produces HTML, Markdown, and JSON reports with run history and delta tracking. Optional --fix opens a draft PR that safely removes dead code via an isolated git worktree — the user's working tree is never touched. Respects an existing knip.json/knip.ts config. Degrades gracefully on non-JS/TS repositories.
